products.title: Antioxidant Shower Gel - Apiceuticals

variants.description:
PROPOWAX™ SERIES
ANTIOXIDANT • ANTIPOLLUTION

100% Clean, Sustainable, Cruelty-free Beauty
10.1 fl. oz. / 300 ml

The PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Shower Gel transforms daily cleansing into a protective ritual. With its unique honey-like texture, it cocoons the skin in silky softness while cleansing gently. Powered by the patented Living Honeycomb, proven to deliver the highest antioxidant activity worldwide, it shields against pollution, slows skin aging, and maintains long-lasting hydration. Leaves skin soft, radiant, and enveloped in Apiceuticals’ ultra-luxury fragrance.

How to Use: Apply 2–3 teaspoons of shower gel to wet skin. Create a rich lather and massage gently in circular motions from top to bottom, letting its honey-like texture cocoon your body. Rinse thoroughly with warm (not hot) water and pat skin dry, leaving some moisture.

Complete the ritual with PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Body Lotion or PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Dry Oil to lock in hydration.

Ingredients and Safety: Aqua (Water), Ammonium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Parfum (Fragrance), Glycerin, Honey/mel, Melissa Officinalis Flower Extract, PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Disodium EDTA, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Caramel, Hexyl Cinnamal.

details_sections.heading: Golden Ingredients
details_sections.body:
Patented PROPOWAX™ LIVING HONEYCOMB
Powerful Antioxidant Activity

A revolutionary technology where a real honeycomb capsule is placed in every bottle. It continuously releases antioxidants during use, repairing oxidative damage and protecting against pollution, UV, and stress. It restores skin balance and strengthens the barrier.

ORGANIC HONEY
Seals in moisture

Rich in amino acids, vitamins, and minerals, it deeply hydrates and seals moisture, cocooning skin in softness and radiance. Honey is nature’s silk — leaving skin supple, smooth, and luminous.

ORGANIC BEE PROPOLIS
Ensures proper scalp hygiene

A natural shield with antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory powers. It reinforces the skin barrier, calms irritation, and balances the microbiome.

MELISSA HYDROSOL (Lemon Balm)
Purifying & Soothing

A refreshing botanical water that purifies and balances the skin. Known as “the calming herb”, Melissa soothes irritation and refreshes the skin, leaving it light, soft, and clean.

VIEW INCI LIST

details_sections.heading: FAQ
details_sections.body:
Is it free of SLS/SLES, Parabens, Silicones?

YES. Apiceuticals Clean Beauty excludes over 2,000 harmful ingredients. Strictly dermatologically tested with 0% irritation cases.

Is the honeycomb inside real?

Yes – the patented PROPOWAX™ Living Honeycomb is real. It continuously infuses antioxidants into the shower gel and onto your skin.

Why are antioxidants important for body care?

Because daily exposure to pollution, UV, and stressors creates free radicals that damage skin and speed up aging. Antioxidants neutralize these effects, keeping skin smooth, youthful, and healthy.

Is it suitable for sensitive skin?

Yes – dermatologically tested on sensitive skin with 0% irritation, redness, or edema. Gentle enough for daily use.

How does it smell?

WOODS OF ARCADIA
Apiceuticals' Signature Scent

– an ultra-luxury, fine fragrance created for haute perfumery.

Experience a true utopia of bliss with a spicy base from vanilla and sandalwood, rising through a sensual heart of cedarwood and blackberry, and finishing with heavenly top notes of citrus and pink pepper.

This is “Woods of Arcadia” – soft, golden, and quietly powerful – an olfactory signature of elegance, nature, and timeless luxury.

Fragrance Key Pyramid Notes:
Top: Citrus Notes, Pink Pepper, Cardamom
Middle: Apricot, Blackberry, Cedarwood
Base: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Agarwood
